caption: The image shows a dark brown metal coffee pot positioned upright against a plain, light beige background. The coffee pot has a curved handle on the left side and a long, slightly upward-tilted spout on the right. It has a conical body that widens toward the base and a round, lidded top with a small knob. The surface of the pot is decorated with painted motifs including a yellow bird perched on a leafy branch with several green leaves, as well as round, red fruit-like shapes scattered around the bird and foliage. The decorative painting on the pot is concentrated on the central portion of its body. There is also a small, neat signature that reads "M. Saltzmann" near the bottom right of the pot. The overall composition is centered with the object isolated on an untextured, monochrome background.
title: Toleware Coffee Pot
